task.title: Debounce context refresh deferred warnings
task.summary: Reduce noisy CodeWiki context-refresh deferred notifications while preserving safe reset boundary checks.

goal.outcome: Context refresh deferral no longer warns every turn while still refusing unsafe reset boundaries.
acceptance: Repeated non-idle deferrals for the same pending refresh notify at most once until a safe boundary or new reason occurs.
Deferral notification is downgraded from warning to info for normal non-idle retries.
Hard safety gates remain unchanged: no auto-pickup when agent is not idle or pending messages exist.
Smoke guard covers deferred-warning debounce behavior.
non_goals: Do not bypass idle/pending-message safety checks.
Do not change context reset configuration defaults.
Do not alter publication or remote push behavior.

exit_criteria: Repeated non-idle deferred refresh notifications are emitted at most once per pending request/reason.
Normal agent-not-idle deferrals use info severity instead of warning.
Adapter capability/other unsafe-boundary deferrals can still warn.
Reset lifecycle gate remains unchanged and still blocks unsafe context reset/pickup.
